C1178.title: SoundCloud Data Breach Listed by HIBP as Affecting About 29.8 Million Accounts
C1178.summary: Have I Been Pwned listed the SoundCloud incident as a breach affecting about 29.8 million accounts, with exposed data including email addresses and public profile information. SoundCloud's official statement said the incident originated from unauthorized access to an ancillary service dashboard and did not involve passwords, financial data, or core platform systems. The case illustrates how auxiliary system access can expose account profile data.
